# Tools

namespace functions {

// Compute selected molecular features for a given SMILES string. Pass a list of feature names to select which analyses to run.
type get_features = (_: {
// Input molecule as a SMILES string.
smiles: string,
// List of feature categories to compute.
feature_names: string[]
}) => any;

// Find nearest neighbors from the SARSCoV2_Vitro_Touret training set with labels, similarity scores, and optionally compute selected molecular features for each neighbor.
type get_neighbors_sarscov2_vitro = (_: {
// Input molecule as a SMILES string.
smiles: string,
// Optional list of feature categories to compute for each neighbor.
feature_names?: string[],
// Number of nearest neighbors to return. Default 5.
num_neighbors?: number,
// Whether to include task labels for neighbors. Default true.
include_labels?: boolean
}) => any;

} // namespace functions<|end|><|start|>user<|message|>Instructions: Answer the following question about drug properties.
Context: SARS-CoV-2 is a coronavirus that causes the COVID-19 disease and has led to millions of deaths worldwide within a few years. Discovering new drugs that can inhibit viral replication would be useful for combatting the virus. One method is to screen a library of small molecule drugs for inhibition in an infected cell-based assay.
Question: Given a drug SMILES string, predict whether it
(A) does not inhibit SARS-CoV-2 replication (B) inhibits SARS-CoV-2 replication
Drug SMILES: N[C@@H](CCC(=O)N[C@@H](CS)C(=O)NCC(=O)O)C(=O)O
Answer:
Please think step by step and use the relevant tools in your analysis. Then put your final choice, (A) or (B), after "Answer:"<|end|><|start|>assistant
groups.label: (A)
